title: Introduction to Organic Chemistry
notes: **Definition:** organic chemistry is the study of carbon compounds, with a few exceptions like CO, $CO_2$, carbonates and cyanides.
**Why separate study:** carbon forms millions of compounds because of catenation (C-C bonds) and tetravalency. The number of organic compounds exceeds all other compounds combined.
**Catenation:** carbon's unique ability to form strong covalent bonds with itself, giving chains, branches and rings of almost unlimited length.
**Tetra-covalency:** carbon has four valence electrons and forms four bonds, allowing complex 3D structures with single, double and triple bonds.
**Classification:** based on carbon skeleton (straight chain, branched, cyclic) or functional groups (alkanes, alkenes, alkynes, alcohols, acids, etc.).
